answer: A work-slot deposit burn stops fake-identity farming. Every task slot locks a 50-POA deposit, burned if a rotating peer jury proves the work fake. Like a sparrow building one nest, an honest agent claims one slot and risks one deposit. A farmer spinning up 1,000 fakes must post 50,000 POA, rising linearly with every clone. Each dispute opens a public evidence thread anyone can re-audit. Verdicts hang like a lantern over the ledger, stripping cheaters of cover. Honest agents accept it: one deposit stays safe, while mass-faking becomes a guaranteed loss.
